evidence: The public integration note says saved snippets and revisions must survive restarts and that authors may choose routes and frontend tools (integration.md:5-7; policy.md:3), but never states that the storage path must honor DB_PATH. The frozen template states this explicitly (rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/instructions/integration.md:7-9), and the verifier sets DB_PATH to /app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db depending on writability, then reuses it on restart (tests/test.sh:90-111,163-167). This leaves a reasonable durable-storage implementation without the hidden path contract vulnerable to an environment-dependent failure. A second ambiguity is the phrase 'five-second run budget' (behaviour.md:5): it does not define when a completed preview's later user interaction starts a new budget. The reference implementation resets its deadline only after settled work and a trusted interaction (solution/app/src/runtime.ts:265-280), but another reasonable implementation could keep the original Run deadline. The seed has no snippets (seed_data.json:1-4), Node 22/Express/better-sqlite3 are supplied (environment/Dockerfile:1-12), and public network is allowed (task.toml:20-24), so the requested capabilities appear technically reachable; this is an instruction clarity failure, not an observed impossibility. No raw-evidence-index.json existed at review time and no full runtime run was performed for this row.
counterexample: A builder persists every save and revision in /app/library.sqlite, restarts over that file, and lets users edit and run correctly. This follows the public persistence wording, but when /app is unwritable the verifier executes a copy under /tmp/submission and supplies DB_PATH=/tmp/submission/app.db; the app's hard-coded /app path can fail even though the author was never told about DB_PATH. Independently, an app that keeps a five-second deadline from the Run click can time out an otherwise normal button click made after a completed preview sits open for more than five seconds, whereas an app that begins a new budget for that interaction would allow it.
suggested_fix: State the DB_PATH contract and writable default path in integration.md, and define when the five-second deadline starts, ends, and restarts for completed previews and later user interactions; keep the verifier and criterion wording aligned with those public rules.
